prompt:
Use the Echo Catwalk reference solely to preserve his identity. The same ADULT MAN must appear in all 15 cells: medium-brown skin, visibly masculine face, short spiky dark-teal hair, teal forehead band, unmistakable trimmed dark-teal beard and mustache, compact athletic build, teal sleeveless jersey and shorts with dark-purple trim, black knee pads, teal-black shoes and wristbands. Never depict a woman, ponytail, long hair or clean-shaven face. Exactly two arms and two legs. Right-facing original art.

Create a transparent RGBA production sheet of 1536x1024 pixels, strict five equal columns by three rows, row-major, exactly fifteen distinct complete full-body poses of the same athlete. Keep every figure inside its cell, with broad transparent gutters. No court, hoop, floor, background, effects, shadows, lettering, teammate, opponent or props. Crisp outlined 1990s arcade pixel art.

Echo performs a one-handed windmill dunk: 0 running approach; 1 longer stride; 2 gathers close to chest around invisible ball; 3 leaps; 4 brings imaginary ball up; 5 moves ball-hand out wide; 6 swings it through a broad circular windmill path; 7 arm sweeps down and around; 8 continues circular swing across shoulder level; 9 rises and rotates the arm overhead; 10 reaches above rim for one-hand release (hand empty); 11 follows through; 12 descends; 13 lands with flexed knees; 14 balances upright. Show clear arm rotation, body and leg continuity. Do not draw a basketball or any prop; keep both hands empty and anatomically distinct. Echo's ball is tracked independently in runtime and must not be embedded in the drawings.

All 15 figures complete, consistent identity and scale, no cropped hair, limbs or shoes. Transparent alpha-zero background/gutters, no haze or checkerboard. Return only the sheet.

review.notes: All 15 poses preserve Echo’s male identity, beard, headband, hair, build, teal uniform and separate limbs. Sequential running, gather, jump, broad one-arm overhead sweep, release/follow-through and landing. Empty hands/no ball. Windmill arm path reads more as a broad overhead arc than a full circular rotation; visual review considers it acceptable for this low-resolution action atlas.

ballTrack.art: none; independent Echo-specific runtime basketball track
ballTrack.notes: Do not merge ball with another athlete path; ball carry/release timing is authored by runtime.

cleanup.method: Per 5x3 cell retain largest alpha>=32 athlete component plus its 2px antialias fringe; clear generated background haze. Packed with package-dunk15.py --isolate-components.
